title: Managing Director, Mexico
locations: Mexico City, Ciudad de Mexico, Mexico
teaser: Become part of our team as Managing Director, Mexico, leading direct account and architecture teams to drive portfolio profitability and strategic growth. Shape the vision for large-scale architectural deals and influence customer purchasing decisions. Ideal for experienced leaders with a strong background in sales and strategic account management.
description:
We are looking for a person who will manage direct account and architecture teams, who will be accountable for the team performance and portfolio profitability, serving as an influencer in customers purchasing decisions. 

Build and sustain strong, long-term relationships with broad range of customer and buyer stakeholders (e.g., CTO, CIO, CFO, Purchasing leaders, Partner Executive, LOB, Buyer or Partner sales managers and decision makers) is part of this role.

Success Measures varies substantially by Geo/Segment; may include:, Team performance metrics (build, manage effective team, attract/retain top talent), Goal attainment, Recurring Revenue, Renewal rates, Territory YOY growth, New logos

Meet the Team

You'll be part of the Latin America Sales team, reporting to the region Sales VP

Your Impact

Typically leads large and complex teams managing global strategic portfolios/accounts and/or cross-architecture deals across Cisco’s most strategic accounts

Sets the strategic vision for multi-year, multi-faceted architectural deals with top-tier accounts in alignment with corporate objectives and market trends

Manages to financial and strategic objectives, including market penetration, large-scale business transformation, and enterprise customer growth

Oversees global capacity modeling and investment prioritization for sustainable revenue growth

Harmonizes global forecasting frameworks across diverse geographies, ensuring a unified approach

Liaises with executive stakeholders to align field strategy and partner/virtual GTM strategies

Orchestrates complex, long-term engagements that shape Cisco’s market leadership

Implements a proactive and sustainable approach to sales challenges, employing feedback and data to refine techniques and drive measurable improvements

Inspires and develops leadership capabilities within field account teams, enabling readiness to lead high-impact initiatives and company-wide investment strategies

Champions mentoring programs designed to drive exceptional quota performance

Synthesizes diverse viewpoints to inform critical GTM strategies

Minimum Qualifications

+ 17 years of related experience, 

Previous leading manager experience in sales roles

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelors or Master’s degree or equivalent experience. 

Technical background

AI enthusiasts
